integrity: Exact symbolic proof of the criterion; rational finite checks are reproducibility evidence rather than an infinite proof. All source claims explicitly compared as limited in review.
scientific_limitations: No statement for extra candidate sites, additional agents, strategic location reports, unequal weights, or maximum/nearest (as opposed to maximum/average) agent costs; arXiv:2507.17063 complete primary text was not accessible for full-text comparison; no independent audit.
scientific_scope: Three distinct sites in an arbitrary metric, one unit-weight agent per site, two distinct facilities chosen from these sites; independently varying individual maximum-distance and average-distance costs.
title: A sharp type-blindness threshold for three-site mixed-cost committees
